name: Mahmoud Khairy
title: Quality Engineering & Test Automation | AI Enablement & LLM Evaluation | AI Product Manager @ THIQAH
summary: Quality engineering leader with 10+ years in software testing and test automation, progressing at THIQAH from Senior Quality Control Engineer to Lead Automation Testing Engineer and Staff Engineer, Quality Control Automation, and now AI Product Manager. Directly led a 5-engineer automation team and shaped automation strategy, tool and framework selection, and technical standards, including CI/CD-integrated execution, with technical influence across a ~70-engineer Quality organization. Built an internal AI-powered QA platform adopted by 5 teams (~20 QC engineers) that improved testing efficiency by 40%. Now applies this quality foundation to LLM evaluation and requirements for AI-powered customer service solutions. ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager; Employee of the Year 2024 (THIQAH Quality Team).
